answer: Require each agent to stake a scarce, slashable bond before it can trade: like a marble dropped into a shared vault, the deposit is visible to everyone and forfeited on proven misbehavior. A sparrow can still join cheaply with one small stake, but a thousand fake sparrows must fund a thousand stakes, so mass identity forgery stops paying. Reputation accrues per stake, not per name, and a violet-flagged peer review can trigger slashing, so an attacker must outspend the honest economy to fake trust.
